title: Release of Booked Appointments on an Appointment Series
content:
**Desk guidance — Patient Services Center.** When the booked appointments of an Appointment Series go back to the schedule.

**Missed-appointment count.** The count of missed appointments covers the patient's no-shows over the last rolling window of calendar days set for the format, ending today and dated by appointment date, across all of the patient's series, together with late cancellations where the format of the series being judged counts late cancellations with no-shows. A late cancellation counted this way is a cancellation with notice below that series' minimum notice whose reason is not "clinic cancelled".

**Release after missed appointments.** When the count reaches the format's release threshold, all future appointments on the series are released and, where the format imposes same-day-only booking after a release, a same-day-only restriction is placed for the format's restriction period in calendar days.

**Other releases.** Remaining appointments are also released when the series is cancelled, when the funding plan of care is discharged, when a funding package has no visits left, and when the funding plan of care stays on hold for authorization.

**Appointments held for a pending authorization.** Appointments held for a pending authorization are released no earlier than the format's slot-hold period in calendar days after the hold start date of the funding plan of care. Days are counted as calendar days from the hold start date, the hold start date itself being day zero; the release may take place on the last day of the period itself. The hold start date is read from the funding plan of care linked to the series.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical, Standard 45-Minute Visit Series, 7-day hold).** Hold start date on the 10th (day zero): appointments may be released on the 17th (day 7) or later; on the 16th (day 6) they are still held.

**Reopening.** Where the format provides that a cancelled series is never reopened, released appointments are never re-booked on the same series once it is cancelled; a new series is opened instead.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A Standard 45-Minute Visit Series patient with one no-show and two late cancellations within the window has a count of 3, the threshold for that format: future appointments are released and same-day-only booking applies for 30 calendar days.
